DDS_GLOBAL.definition: standard sequential DDS in formal normalized [0,1]^14

DDS_SOFT_AI.evaluation_17_onward: standard sequential DDS in formal normalized [0,1]^14

criteria.auc_rule: paired AUC delta mean > 0 and its paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
criteria.final_precision_rule: SOFT_AI final mean is no more than the predeclared tolerance below GLOBAL and the paired final-delta CI is not wholly negative

region.region_definition: median of Transformer qobs (5 seeds plus ensemble median), Ridge qobs, A1 Top1 synthetic inverse predictions on the best 20 fixed test cases, and A1 historical best-broad candidates; interval is widened by robust source quantiles and normalized padding.
